title: The Truth About Real Estate Referrals (What Most Agents Get Wrong) 2026
description:
Choosing the right trusted partners in real estate can make or break your business. In this episode, we discuss why referrals matter, how partnerships work, and what most real estate agents get wrong when choosing collaborators.

If you're in the real estate industry or planning to work with agents, this conversation will help you avoid costly partnership mistakes.

In this episode:
• Why trusted partners are critical in real estate
• The real truth about referral networks
• Common mistakes agents make
• How to build long-term business relationships

Subscribe for more real estate insights and practical strategies.
